description: A shell script for publishing an npm package, handling version queries, publish targets, and executing an npm publish command with environment-specific parameters.
external_methods: require() from Node.js to load package.json
node -p command for extracting package version
node --import tsx --input-type=module for executing TypeScript code inline

methods.name: main script logic
methods.description: Handles command-line arguments, validates input, determines publish target, calls Node.js to get release plan, constructs npm publish command, and executes it.
